workData.title: MYCITY
workData.subTitle: Redesigned MYCITY’s website and app for clarity and usability while shaping MyPlace for Office, an IoT-powered smart office solution.

content.text: Role
Senior Product Designer
Project Space
IoT-based Digital Platform
0-1 Projects
B2B
B2C
SaaS

I joined MYCITY, a company specializing in behavior analysis technology through IoT devices, as a Product Designer to redesign their website and app. My goal was to enhance clarity and usability, ensuring their complex services were effectively communicated and user-friendly.

Additionally, I contributed to the design of “MyPlace for Office”, an IoT-powered smart office service that helps employees find optimal workspaces, track colleagues, and manage office resources efficiently.
The MYCITY website previously lacked depth and clarity, making it difficult to explain its advanced IoT solutions, including:
Colleague Location Tracking
Air Conditioning Control
Shared Space Congestion Monitoring
Workplace Analytics / Visualization
Hypothesis
Illustrations would effectively communicate MYCITY’s services while avoiding visual clutter.
An intuitive interface would improve engagement and comprehension for website and app users.
Website Redesign
Used illustrations to simplify complex IoT concepts and enhance visual appeal.
Developed a comprehensive design system for consistency across platforms.
MyPlace for Office App Design
Created a user-friendly interface for location tracking, air conditioning control, and congestion monitoring.
Focused on clear navigation and minimalistic layouts to streamline usability.
Enhanced Features
Expanded the website with instructional visuals to improve service understanding.
Integrated real-time data visualization for workplace tracking and optimization.
Impact
The redesigned website improved user understanding and client engagement by presenting MYCITY’s services clearly.
The MyPlace for Office app streamlined employee tracking, gaining positive feedback for its usability and workplace optimization features.
Learning
Simplified visuals, such as illustrations, are effective in explaining complex IoT services.
User-friendly designs paired with advanced IoT technology improve client trust and platform adoption.
Integrating user feedback into design strategies ensures seamless, scalable solutions.
This project positioned MYCITY as a leader in behavior analysis and IoT technology, delivering tools that enhance workplace productivity and user experience.

next.title: Sotheby's
next.subTitle: Led the UX/UI design lifecycle at Sotheby’s, integrating user research to drive the strategic roadmap and enhance digital experiences in the luxury market.

content.text: Role
Senior Product Designer, Consultant
Project Space
E-commerce
B2C
Growth Design

As a Senior Product Designer and Consultant, I joined Sotheby’s product design team to integrate insights from user research, including interviews and analysis, into design strategies. I supported the strategic roadmap and product vision, adapting to the fast-paced auction and luxury goods markets. I also led the entire UX/UI design lifecycle—from research and design to testing and delivery—while ensuring the successful execution of deliverables.

Sotheby’s operates in a highly competitive and fast-evolving market, where continuous innovation and platform improvements are essential. The project’s primary goals were to enhance key functionalities such as payments, accounts, and shipping while maintaining consistent UX/UI across all platforms to deliver a seamless, user-friendly experience.
Hypothesis
Integrating user research and usability testing into the design process would result in more user-centric features and increased satisfaction.
Competitive analysis and stakeholder collaboration would support defining objectives and uncovering improvement opportunities.
Iterative design and testing cycles would enhance platform usability, boost user engagement, and reinforce the brand’s digital identity.
End-to-End Design Process
Led all stages of the UX/UI design lifecycle, including research, wireframing, prototyping, testing, and delivery.
Collaborated with product managers and stakeholders to define design goals and set clear directions.
User-Centric Design Execution
Developed personas, user journeys, and scenarios to align with user needs and goals.
Designed low-fidelity system flows, wireframes, and prototypes to quickly validate ideas.
Delivered high-fidelity UI designs and prototypes tailored to devices and screen breakpoints for development teams to implement.
Iterative Improvement and Collaboration
Analyzed user and stakeholder feedback to refine designs and improve usability.
Design System Contribution
Utilized and contributed to the design system to maintain consistency across platforms.
Collaborated with design leadership to advance UX practices and foster a design-driven culture within the organization.
Impact
Increased Engagement / Trust
: Improved user satisfaction and retention with intuitive UX/UI, thorough testing, and enhanced features like payments and accounts.
Stronger Brand Identity
: Delivered a unified, luxury digital experience across platforms.
Scalable Design System
: Streamlined workflows and optimized future product development.
Sustained Digital Success
: Despite a decline in overall sales from 2021 to 2023, online sales remained higher than pre-pandemic levels.
Learning
User Research / Testing
: Reinforced the role of user-centric design in driving effective solutions.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
: Highlighted how teamwork and iteration boost innovation.
Adapting to Digital Shifts
: Showcased the importance of agile digital strategies in maintaining relevance and driving growth in a post-pandemic market.
This project demonstrated how strategic leadership and user-centered design create scalable, impactful digital solutions.
